title: Which control refused the call
lede: Two mechanisms can refuse a model call at different points, and each writes a different kind of evidence.

steps.title: Before the provider: AI Guard
steps.what: The guardrail runs before the provider is called; a block returns a 400 whose message names the category, such as prompt injection.
steps.why: AI Guard is configured per agent key, not per app. Block events carry OWASP, MITRE ATLAS and NIST mappings.

steps.title: Route checks name their reason
steps.what: Wrong-provider and model-allowlist refusals are 403 responses on the model routes whose body names the reason.
steps.why: Bare 403s on MCP and A2A routes instead need the gateway log.

steps.title: After the provider: Cedar
steps.what: A Cedar policy can withhold content from a completion, for example personal data; the provider has already answered.
steps.why: The live-verified denial logged decision, policy IDs, principal and agent key, with no compliance mapping.
